arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Caldwell argued Congress never intended to cap front pay.
She cited Section 2 of the Act to support her view.
Mr. Roberts argued front pay is not subject to the cap.
Mr. Ripple described the division of responsibilities between judge and jury.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of the 1991 Civil Rights Act. The Act added caps on certain damages. The parties disagree on how to classify front pay.
